title: Image comparison study
consent: I agree that my answers are recorded for research. My name will not be published.
quality_full: Which side's images look better? Think of how natural they look, and of visible seams, cut-off objects or other flaws.
alignment_full: Which side's images match their texts better? Check each image against its own text.
diversity_full: On which side do the two images differ more clearly in the highlighted parts?
connection: Connection problem. Please check your internet connection.
unsent: Some answers are still being sent. Please keep this page open for a moment.
more_lead: Have a few more minutes? You can answer more questions.
test_mode: Test mode: answers are not saved.
start_lead: Thank you for helping! You will compare pictures made by two image-generation methods. It takes about 12 minutes.
layout_prompts: The text the pictures were made from. There are two texts, ① and ②, and they differ only in the colored words: ① in yellow, ② in blue.
layout_left: The left side: two pictures made by one method, one from each text.
layout_right: The right side: the same two texts, made by another method.
layout_questions: Your answers: for each of three questions, choose the better side.
questions_left: means the left side is better,
questions_right: means the right side is better.
questions_tie: Choose Tie when they are about the same.
tip_zoom: Tap a picture to enlarge it, next to the other side's picture of the same text.
tip_landscape: On a phone, hold it sideways.
tip_time: There are 25 questions, about 12 minutes in all. If you stop, you can continue later on the same device.
tip_no_right: There are no right or wrong answers; we want your impression.
ready_lead: 25 questions, about 12 minutes. You can open these instructions again at any time with the ? button.
diversity_note: Only the highlighted parts count. Ignore differences anywhere else in the picture.
exit_body: Your answers will be deleted from this device and will not be used in the study.
exited_body: Nothing you answered will be used. Thank you for your time!
